text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One night, while I'm organizing some<n>files in my
office...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I was hoping to borrow you for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember at the end of<n>summer camp how
I said there was<n>something I wanted to do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to issue a challenge to<n>someone. Could
you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober leads us through the<n>campus until
we finally meet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You're already here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes. I came a bit early to watch the<n>sunset.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now then...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What is it you wished to say to me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to thank you for everything<n>you've done for
me up until now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You've guided me through so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
When I had just entered Tracen and<n>was too
flustered by the male<n>teachers, you were the one to
help<n>me study...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And when I was worried about the<n>differences
between myself and<n>other Mejiros like McQueen
and<n>Ryan, you were the one to give me an<n>ideal to
chase after.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You came to watch my debut race<n>and reassured
me when I was<n>overcome with fear before the
Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You knocked some sense into me<n>when I felt as if I
was going to lose<n>the battle against myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm going to become "Mejiro Dober."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even if I have people I admire, I'm<n>not going to
compare myself to them.<n>I'm going to become a
unique light in<n>this world like none other.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Will you please accept this?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As she says this, Mejiro Dober holds<n>out a single
flower to Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course... I would be glad to.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: With a smile, Air Groove reaches out...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And accepts the yellow carnation<n>from Mejiro
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
In the language of flowers, yellow<n>carnations mean
"jealousy." Usually,<n>people avoid using such a
message...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But there are some among us who<n>purposefully
choose to gift this flower<n>to others.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For example, to their incredible and<n>accomplished
mother...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Or to a role model we admire. With<n>that gift we
declare...

text_block_list.name: Dober and Groove
text_block_list.text: I will surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I see you remembered.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I haven't forgotten a single thing<n>you've taught me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: After all, I idolize you. You are my<n>ideal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Which means you are also the person<n>I want to
surpass the most!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to surpass you, Air Groove,<n>and create
my own path as Mejiro<n>Dober!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting for you at the Queen<n>Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What a remarkable challenge that<n>was.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm so relieved she accepted it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thanks for accompanying me,<n>Trainer.
choice_data_list: No problem, but why did you want me there?
No problem, but why did you want me there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Isn't it obvious?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I mean...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You've guided me through a lot too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to declare my intentions for<n>the future in
front of both you and Air<n>Groove today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove understood that. That's<n>why she didn't
say anything even<n>when she noticed you standing
there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haha! What are you thanking me for?<n>You're so
weird!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I will never forget her face at that<n>moment, shining
in the light of the<n>setting sun...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The preliminary to the Queen<n>Elizabeth II Cup, the
Fuchu<n>Umamusume Stakes, is right around<n>the
corner!
